name: ai-security-sdlc
description: Agent plugins for securing an AI-first SDLC: secure agent setup and starter templates, secure-by-design planning, AI evals, red teaming, pentest, SAST and remediation.

plugins.name: secure-sdlc
plugins.description: Entry point for the ai-security-sdlc toolkit: SDLC orientation and secure agent setup with starter templates and opt-in hooks (security-guidance), the shared app security profile, an index-routed security-standards knowledge corpus, intent-to-spec-to-plan security planning with CodeGuard-backed Secure Build Plans, and remediation that closes findings back into standards and plans, plus a pattern for business-logic hooks at the pre-tool-call layer whose first rule, the mcp-install gate, asks the user for consent before an agent installs an MCP server, and an install-hooks skill that wires it into Codex, Cursor, Copilot and Gemini.

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Verify the code you ship: a seven-lane blind scanner ensemble (semgrep, CodeQL, Trivy, OSV-Scanner, zizmor, an open-ended model review and a threat-model-driven source-to-sink model audit) whose serious candidates face a blind three-lens verification panel and a computed gate, triaged into one ranked SARIF with a coverage receipt; CodeQL CI setup and read-back; and autonomous Strix DAST pentesting — results into .ai-security/results for remediation.

plugins.name: verify-ai
plugins.description: Verify the AI layer: Promptfoo baseline evals and curated cyber benchmarks (b3, CyberSecEval 4, JailbreakBench), multi-turn adversarial red teaming configured from the security profile, and supply-chain scans of packaged AI assets (models, MCP servers, skills) — findings into .ai-security/results for remediation.

plugins.name: verify-ai-adversarial
plugins.description: Offline red teaming of the AI layer with promptfoo: the official promptfoo red-team skills vendored verbatim, plus an approved 60-goal multi-turn Crescendo corpus generated by promptfoo from core OWASP LLM, Agentic and MCP Top 10 risks (tiers 20/20/20), one commented config for target, attacker and judge over OpenAI-compatible endpoints (depth 10 with backtracking, optional guardrail-aware grading), and an egress-proving wrapper plus hook that keep every run off promptfoo cloud — findings into .ai-security/results for remediation.
